DHAKA, May 2, 2023 (BSS) - Indian high commissioner in Dhaka Pranay Verma today said improved and uninterrupted connectivity could increase export of Bangladeshi products to India by 300 percent.

"Studies indicate that seamless connectivity between India and Bangladesh has the potential to increase national income by 17 percent in Bangladesh and 8 percent in India," he said.
